names: Old Church of Our Lady Mary of Zion
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap locates the older church envelope south of the new cathedral. The modern standing footprint controls registration. Published archaeological measurements inform the surrounding podium and stair.

note: The 1893 view published in Bent shows three square portico openings, raised corner details and a low crenellated roof. Archaeological sources date the later arches and pitched roof to 1908.
